row.name: MSC Industrial Direct Company Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=33 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.51 tightness=0.84 base_volume_vs_leg=0.84 base_volume_vs_avg=0.99
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 33 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.51 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 3.1% vs its 20-SMA, 4.9% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: Two hard checklist failures drive this to skip: C fails on both base length (33 sessions, well outside the 3–20 window) and a giveback of 0.51 — more than half the prior leg surrendered inside the base — and VOL fails because the burst bar traded below the prior session and only 1.2× the 50-day average against a required 1.5× for a base this long. The chart confirms the base: the shaded box from late July through mid-September shows a wide, multi-month sideways chop with overlapping bars and no tightening, consistent with the measured 51% giveback and 33-session length.
claude.key_risk: The base is structurally too long and too deep, and volume on the signal bar is insufficient for a base of this duration — follow-through probability is materially lower than a clean setup.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open regardless of gap direction; the two hard failures (C and VOL) are not resolved by price action at the open.
